segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and we're going to be purchasing some wine today, right Marco?
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，我们今天要买一些酒，对吧，马可？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to go to the shop and we're going to try to look for some wine that will go well with the type of food that we're having.
segments.zh: 今天我们要去商店，我们将尝试寻找一些与我们所拥有的食物类型相得益彰的葡萄酒。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we're going to be learning a lot of specific terms.
segments.zh: 所以我们将学习很多具体的术语。

segments.en: This is an advanced lesson.
segments.zh: 这是一个高级课程。

segments.en: So we expect that most of the basics you already know, but some of these more difficult words and phrases are going to be our focus.
segments.zh: 因此，我们希望您已经知道的大多数基础知识，但其中一些更难的单词和短语将成为我们的重点。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的对话。

segments.en: Hello there.
segments.zh: 你好。

segments.en: Welcome to Wine World.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到 WineWorld 葡萄酒专卖店。

segments.en: Let me know if I can help you out at all.
segments.zh: 有什么需要帮忙的，尽管告诉我。

segments.en: Yes, please.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，我正需要人帮忙。

segments.en: I could really use some help.
segments.zh: 我正需要人帮忙。

segments.en: I'm going over to my boss's house for dinner tonight and I don't know what kind of wine I should bring.
segments.zh: 今晚我要去老板家吃饭，不知道该带哪种葡萄酒。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Do you know what kind of food will be served?
segments.zh: 您知道晚餐会吃什么吗？

segments.en: Well, his wife is Japanese.
segments.zh: 嗯，他的妻子是日本人。

segments.en: He said she makes really good sushi.
segments.zh: 他说她做的寿司非常好。

segments.en: That's a bit of a challenge.
segments.zh: 这可有点难办。

segments.en: Sushi is notoriously difficult to pair with wine.
segments.zh: 寿司出了名地难搭配葡萄酒。

segments.en: Well, let's see.
segments.zh: 嗯，让我想想。

segments.en: It'll have to be a white wine, of course.
segments.zh: 那当然得选白葡萄酒。

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: Wouldn't a red wine go well with sushi?
segments.zh: 红葡萄酒配寿司不好吗？

segments.en: No, I don't think so.
segments.zh: 不，我不这么认为。

segments.en: Sushi is a very delicately flavored food and red wine would be a jarring contrast.
segments.zh: 寿司口味很细腻，红葡萄酒的味道反差太强。

segments.en: You need a white wine which has more subtle flavors to complement the fish.
segments.zh: 需要风味更柔和的白葡萄酒，才能衬托鱼肉的鲜味。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: So I should get a bottle of Chardonnay.
segments.zh: 那我该买瓶霞多丽。

segments.en: That's a white wine, right?
segments.zh: 那是白葡萄酒吧？

segments.en: Yes, Chardonnay is a white wine, but I'm not sure it'd be your best bet.
segments.zh: 霞多丽确实是白葡萄酒，但恐怕不是最合适的。

segments.en: Chardonnay is one of the more full-bodied whites and tends to be a bit oaky.
segments.zh: 霞多丽属于酒体较饱满的白葡萄酒，通常还带些橡木香。

segments.en: I'd suggest you go for something brighter like this Sauvignon Blanc from New Zealand.
segments.zh: 我建议选清爽些的，比如这款新西兰长相思。

segments.en: Oh, the Sauvignon Blanc?
segments.zh: 哦，长相思？

segments.en: What's that?
segments.zh: 那是什么？

segments.en: That's another varietal or type of grape, just like Chardonnay.
segments.zh: 和霞多丽一样，它也是一个葡萄品种。

segments.en: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我看看。

segments.en: The label says it's got attractive citrus and grassy aromas that give way to crisp mineral flavors and a bone-dry finish.
segments.zh: 酒标上写着：“迷人的柑橘与青草香，接着是清爽的矿物风味，余味极干。”

segments.en: Serve chilled.
segments.zh: 请冰镇后饮用。

segments.en: Oh no, how long will it take to chill the wine?
segments.zh: 糟了，冰镇葡萄酒得花多久？

segments.en: I'm on my way to dinner now.
segments.zh: 我正要去吃晚饭。

segments.en: Oh, it's okay, don't worry.
segments.zh: 哦，没关系，别担心。

segments.en: We'll just choose a wine from the cooler.
segments.zh: 从冷藏柜里挑一瓶就好。

segments.en: We don't have quite as extensive a selection over here, but this Rhone Valley White would be lovely.
segments.zh: 这边选择没那么多，不过这瓶罗讷河谷白葡萄酒很不错。

segments.en: All right, what varietal is that?
segments.zh: 好，那它是什么葡萄品种？

segments.en: Well, this is a French wine, so they don't always specify the varietal on the label.
segments.zh: 这是法国葡萄酒，酒标上不一定会注明葡萄品种。

segments.en: The French believe that the soil a grape is grown in is one of the most important factors in the final flavor of the wine.
segments.zh: 法国人认为，葡萄生长的土壤是决定葡萄酒最终风味的重要因素之一。

segments.en: This wine is probably a blend of a few different types of grapes, mostly Viognier, I'd guess.
segments.zh: 这瓶酒大概由几种葡萄混酿，我猜主要是维欧尼。

segments.en: And you think this is a good wine?
segments.zh: 你认为这是一款好酒吗？

segments.en: Yes, this is one of our best sellers.
segments.zh: 是的，这是我们卖得最好的酒之一。

segments.en: It's not quite as dry as the Sauvignon Blanc we were looking at earlier, which means it's more approachable.
segments.zh: 它没有刚才那瓶长相思那么干，喝起来更容易接受。

segments.en: It's light and crisp with a bit of a vanilla aroma.
segments.zh: 酒体轻盈清爽，还带点香草香。

segments.en: Perfect, I'll take it.
segments.zh: 太好了，就要它。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now we're talking about wines, and one of the first things that really pop up is when we're talking about sushi and how we're trying to get a wine to go well with sushi.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们谈论的是葡萄酒，真正突然出现的事情之一是当我们谈论寿司以及我们如何尝试让葡萄酒与寿司搭配时。

segments.en: All right, so the phrase here was to pair with wine.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这里的短语是与葡萄酒搭配。

segments.en: So sushi is notoriously difficult to pair with wine.
segments.zh: 所以寿司很难与葡萄酒搭配。

segments.en: All right, so when you talk about wine, you talk about pairing it with food, P-A-I-R, to pair.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以当你谈论葡萄酒时，你会谈论将它与食物搭配，P-A-I-R，以配对。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So for example, if you're having meat or poultry or chicken, you try to pair it with a wine so basically that the flavors go well together.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果您有肉、家禽或鸡肉，您会尝试将其与葡萄酒搭配，因此基本上味道很好。

segments.en: So commonly we say that red wine pairs well with red meat, or fish and white wine pair well together.
segments.zh: 所以通常我们说红酒与红肉或鱼和白葡萄酒搭配得很好。

segments.en: So you're pairing these two things means you're using them in the same meal.
segments.zh: 所以你把这两件事配对意味着你在同一顿饭中使用它们。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So when we're talking about pairing a wine with sushi, the girl said, well, what about red wine?
segments.zh: 所以当我们谈论将葡萄酒与寿司搭配时，女孩说，那么红酒呢？

segments.en: Wouldn't that pair well with sushi?
segments.zh: 这不是和寿司搭配吗？

segments.en: And the attendant said, no, the red wine would be a jarring contrast.
segments.zh: 服务员说，不，红酒会是一个不和谐的对比。

segments.en: So first of all, we have this word jarring.
segments.zh: 所以首先，我们有这个词不和谐。

segments.en: Something is jarring if it's loud, shocking, abrasive, difficult, annoying.
segments.zh: 如果它响亮、令人震惊、磨损、困难、烦人，它就会令人不安。

segments.en: So something that's jarring is loud.
segments.zh: 所以和不和谐的东西是响亮的。

segments.en: And a contrast is something that shows the differences in something.
segments.zh: 对比是显示某物差异的东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So when we're saying that it would be a jarring contrast to have sushi with red wine, we're saying that they're just too different.
segments.zh: 所以当我们说寿司和红酒会是一个不和谐的对比时，我们是在说它们太不同了。

segments.en: Sushi is too different from the red wine flavor, so they wouldn't go well together.
segments.zh: 寿司与红酒的味道太不同了，所以它们不会很好地搭配起来。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And since jarring means it's a bad thing, we think the flavor will be wrong.
segments.zh: 由于不和谐意味着这是一件坏事，我们认为味道会是错误的。

segments.en: It'll be bad.
segments.zh: 会很糟糕的。

segments.en: So we need to look for something else.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要寻找别的东西。

segments.en: And the salesperson suggested a wine that has more subtle flavors, white wine.
segments.zh: 销售人员推荐了一种味道更微妙的葡萄酒，白葡萄酒。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this word subtle is actually spelled S-U-B-T-L-E, but the B is silent.
segments.zh: 所以这个词微妙实际上拼写为 S-U-B-T-L-E，但 B 是沉默的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we say subtle.
segments.zh: 所以我们说微妙。

segments.en: And it's actually great because it's kind of like the opposite of jarring.
segments.zh: 它实际上很棒，因为它有点像 Jarring 的反面。

segments.en: Something that's not jarring is subtle.
segments.zh: 不震撼的东西是微妙的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's a little bit more, I don't know, like relaxed, like not as loud.
segments.zh: 所以它有点多，我不知道，喜欢放松，就像没有那么响亮。

segments.en: It's not obvious.
segments.zh: 这并不明显。

segments.en: You have to really think about it and look for it.
segments.zh: 你必须真正考虑并寻找它。

segments.en: Something that's subtle is not obvious.
segments.zh: 微妙的东西并不明显。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And now we're talking about one specific type of white wine.
segments.zh: 现在我们谈论的是一种特定类型的白葡萄酒。

segments.en: We have a Chardonnay.
segments.zh: 我们有一个霞多丽。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we know that there are many, many different kinds of wine out there, but there are some very common ones.
segments.zh: 所以我们知道那里有很多很多不同种类的酒，但也有一些很常见的酒。

segments.en: And Chardonnay is one of those.
segments.zh: 霞多丽就是其中之一。

segments.en: I think Chardonnay tends to be a bit fruitier.
segments.zh: 我认为霞多丽往往有点果味。

segments.en: Australia has some famous Chardonnays.
segments.zh: 澳大利亚有一些著名的霞多丽。

segments.en: California has some famous Chardonnays.
segments.zh: 加利福尼亚有一些著名的霞多丽。

segments.en: Just remember that Chardonnay is a kind of white wine.
segments.zh: 请记住，霞多丽是一种白葡萄酒。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And one of the ways that they used it to describe Chardonnay is that it's one of the more full-bodied whites.
segments.zh: 他们用它来描述霞多丽的一种方式是它是酒体更浓郁的白人之一。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So whites here, we're talking about white wines, but something that's full-bodied.
segments.zh: 所以白人在这里，我们谈论的是白葡萄酒，但酒体浓郁。

segments.en: What does that mean, Marco?
segments.zh: 这意味着什么，马可？

segments.en: So if a wine is full-bodied, it means that it has a little bit of a stronger flavor, like it's a more complete flavor.
segments.zh: 因此，如果葡萄酒酒体浓郁，则意味着它的味道更浓，就像它的味道更完整。

segments.en: It's not as subtle.
segments.zh: 它没有那么微妙。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we know that white wines are a bit more subtle than red wines in this case, but within white wines, you can have one that's very full-bodied.
segments.zh: 所以我们知道在这种情况下，白葡萄酒比红葡萄酒更微妙，但在白葡萄酒中，你可以拥有一种酒体非常浓郁的葡萄酒。

segments.en: So this is a great phrase for describing wine.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的描述葡萄酒的短语。

segments.en: We don't really talk about other things being full-bodied, but wine can be full-bodied if it really has what you say, Marco, this big full taste, a bright taste.
segments.zh: 我们并没有真正谈论其他东西是浓郁的，但如果它真的有你所说的话，马可，这种浓郁的味道，一种明亮的味道，它可以是浓郁的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually the sales attendant suggested that, well, since the Chardonnay is too or is more full-bodied, then he would recommend maybe a Sauvignon Blanc.
segments.zh: 实际上，销售服务员建议，好吧，由于霞多丽太浓郁或酒体更浓郁，那么他可能会推荐长相思。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So Sauvignon Blanc.
segments.zh: 所以长相思。

segments.en: Blanc is the French word for white, but we use this all the time in English.
segments.zh: 白兰地是白人的法语单词，但我们一直用英语使用它。

segments.en: Sauvignon Blanc being the kind of wine.
segments.zh: 长相思是一种葡萄酒。

segments.en: Again, it's a white wine.
segments.zh: 再说，这是一种白葡萄酒。

segments.en: And it's a bit brighter than the Chardonnay.
segments.zh: 它比霞多丽亮一点。

segments.en: That's what the salesperson said.
segments.zh: 销售人员是这么说的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And when we're talking about wines, either red wines or white wines, the way to describe it or the different varieties is actually a varietal of the wines or the type of grape.
segments.zh: 当我们谈论葡萄酒时，无论是红葡萄酒还是白葡萄酒，描述它或不同品种的方式实际上都是葡萄酒或葡萄的种类。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So varietal.
segments.zh: 如此多样。

segments.en: So you think of variety, varietal.
segments.zh: 所以你想到了多样性，品种。

segments.en: Varietal is a specific wine word that we use to describe the kind of grape that go into a wine.
segments.zh: Varietal 是一个特定的酒词，我们用来描述葡萄酒中的葡萄种类。

segments.en: So we know wine generally comes from grapes.
segments.zh: 所以我们知道葡萄酒通常来自葡萄。

segments.en: They're crushed down.
segments.zh: 他们被压垮了。

segments.en: And then the alcohol comes from all the sugars.
segments.zh: 然后酒精来自所有的糖。

segments.en: But each different kind of grape has a different flavor.
segments.zh: 但每种不同的葡萄都有不同的味道。

segments.en: And that's the varietal, the kind of grape.
segments.zh: 这就是品种，葡萄的种类。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So just think of it as the variety of the wines that you have.
segments.zh: 所以把它想象成你拥有的葡萄酒的多样性。

segments.en: And it's a word used specifically for wines.
segments.zh: 这是一个专门用于葡萄酒的词。

segments.en: And well, when the attendant kept talking about the wines and the types of wines they have there, he mentioned that they have a small selection in the refrigerator or in the cooler.
segments.zh: 好吧，当服务员不断谈论他们在那里的葡萄酒和葡萄酒的类型时，他提到他们在冰箱或冷却器中有一小部分可供选择。

segments.en: So selection in this case means what the store has to offer.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下选择意味着商店必须提供的东西。

segments.en: It means all the wines that they sell.
segments.zh: 这意味着他们出售的所有葡萄酒。

segments.en: So maybe if you have an extensive selection, it means you have many, many, many different kinds to choose from.
segments.zh: 所以也许如果你有广泛的选择，这意味着你有很多很多，很多，许多不同的种类可供选择。

segments.en: But if you don't have an extensive selection, you have very few wines, that means that you have fewer things to sell.
segments.zh: 但如果你没有广泛的选择，你的葡萄酒很少，这意味着你可以卖的东西更少。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a wide selection of wines or a small selection of wines.
segments.zh: 因此，多种葡萄酒或少量葡萄酒可供选择。

segments.en: And lastly, talking about varietals, we also have what we call a blend, a blend of a few different types of grapes.
segments.zh: 最后，谈到品种，我们也有我们所说的混合物，一种混合了几种不同类型的葡萄。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you can have blends of different things.
segments.zh: 所以你可以有不同的东西的混合。

segments.en: But in terms of wine, we're talking about using different grapes together to make one wine.
segments.zh: 但在葡萄酒方面，我们正在谈论使用不同的葡萄来酿造一种葡萄酒。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is something that's pretty common and it's a way to achieve different flavors.
segments.zh: 所以这是很常见的事情，也是实现不同口味的一种方式。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a blend.
segments.zh: 所以混合。

segments.en: You also talk about it in, I think, whiskeys.
segments.zh: 你也在谈论它，我想，威士忌。

segments.en: You have blended whiskeys.
segments.zh: 你有混合威士忌。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You can have a single malt, which is one grain in one barrel, or you can have a blend, which would be different grains fermented in different barrels mixed together later.
segments.zh: 你可以有一个麦芽，它是一桶中的一个谷物，或者你可以有一个混合物，不同的谷物在不同的桶中发酵，稍后混合在一起。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of great stuff here all about wines.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多关于葡萄酒的好东西。

segments.en: Let's listen to this dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 我们最后再听一遍这段对话。

segments.en: Hello there.
segments.zh: 你好。

segments.en: Welcome to Wine World.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到 WineWorld 葡萄酒专卖店。

segments.en: Let me know if I can help you out at all.
segments.zh: 有什么需要帮忙的，尽管告诉我。

segments.en: Yes, please.
segments.zh: 好的，请。

segments.en: I could really use some help.
segments.zh: 我正需要人帮忙。

segments.en: I'm going over to my boss's house for dinner tonight and I don't know what kind of wine I should bring.
segments.zh: 今晚我要去老板家吃饭，不知道该带哪种葡萄酒。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Do you know what kind of food will be served?
segments.zh: 您知道晚餐会吃什么吗？

segments.en: Well, his wife is Japanese.
segments.zh: 嗯，他的妻子是日本人。

segments.en: He said she makes really good sushi.
segments.zh: 他说她做的寿司非常好。

segments.en: That's a bit of a challenge.
segments.zh: 这可有点难办。

segments.en: Sushi is notoriously difficult to pair with wine.
segments.zh: 寿司出了名地难搭配葡萄酒。

segments.en: Well, let's see.
segments.zh: 嗯，我们来看看。

segments.en: It'll have to be a white wine, of course.
segments.zh: 那当然得选白葡萄酒。

segments.en: Why wouldn't a red wine go well with sushi?
segments.zh: 为什么红酒不适合寿司？

segments.en: No, I don't think so.
segments.zh: 不，我不这么认为。

segments.en: Sushi is a very delicately flavored food and red wine would be a jarring contrast.
segments.zh: 寿司口味很细腻，红葡萄酒的味道反差太强。

segments.en: You need a white wine which has more subtle flavors to complement the fish.
segments.zh: 需要风味更柔和的白葡萄酒，才能衬托鱼肉的鲜味。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: So I should get a bottle of Chardonnay.
segments.zh: 那我该买瓶霞多丽。

segments.en: That's a white wine, right?
segments.zh: 那是白葡萄酒吧？

segments.en: Yes, Chardonnay is a white wine, but I'm not sure it'd be your best bet.
segments.zh: 霞多丽确实是白葡萄酒，但恐怕不是最合适的。

segments.en: Chardonnay is one of the more full-bodied whites and tends to be a bit oaky.
segments.zh: 霞多丽属于酒体较饱满的白葡萄酒，通常还带些橡木香。

segments.en: I'd suggest you go for something brighter like this Sauvignon Blanc from New Zealand.
segments.zh: 我建议选清爽些的，比如这款新西兰长相思。

segments.en: Oh, the Sauvignon Blanc?
segments.zh: 哦，长相思？

segments.en: What's that?
segments.zh: 那是什么？

segments.en: That's another varietal or type of grape, just like Chardonnay.
segments.zh: 和霞多丽一样，它也是一个葡萄品种。

segments.en: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: The label says it's got attractive citrus and grassy aromas that give way to crisp mineral flavors and a bone-dry finish.
segments.zh: 酒标上写着：“迷人的柑橘与青草香，接着是清爽的矿物风味，余味极干。”

segments.en: Serve chilled.
segments.zh: 请冰镇后饮用。

segments.en: Oh no, how long will it take to chill the wine?
segments.zh: 糟了，冰镇葡萄酒得花多久？

segments.en: I'm on my way to dinner now.
segments.zh: 我正要去吃晚饭。

segments.en: Oh, it's okay.
segments.zh: 哦，没关系。

segments.en: Don't worry.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: We'll just choose a wine from the cooler.
segments.zh: 从冷藏柜里挑一瓶就好。

segments.en: We don't have quite as extensive a selection over here, but this Rhone Valley White would be lovely.
segments.zh: 这边选择没那么多，不过这瓶罗讷河谷白葡萄酒很不错。

segments.en: All right, what varietal is that?
segments.zh: 好，那它是什么葡萄品种？

segments.en: Well, this is a French wine, so they don't always specify the varietal on the label.
segments.zh: 这是法国葡萄酒，酒标上不一定会注明葡萄品种。

segments.en: The French believe that the soil a grape is grown in is one of the most important factors in the final flavor of the wine.
segments.zh: 法国人认为，葡萄生长的土壤是决定葡萄酒最终风味的重要因素之一。

segments.en: This wine is probably a blend of a few different types of grapes, mostly Viognier, I'd guess.
segments.zh: 这瓶酒大概由几种葡萄混酿，我猜主要是维欧尼。

segments.en: And you think this is a good wine?
segments.zh: 你认为这是一款好酒吗？

segments.en: Yes, this is one of our best sellers.
segments.zh: 是的，这是我们卖得最好的酒之一。

segments.en: It's not quite as dry as the Sauvignon Blanc we were looking at earlier, which means it's more approachable.
segments.zh: 它没有刚才那瓶长相思那么干，喝起来更容易接受。

segments.en: It's light and crisp with a bit of a vanilla aroma.
segments.zh: 酒体轻盈清爽，还带点香草香。

segments.en: Perfect.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: I'll take it.
segments.zh: 我要这个。

segments.en: All right, so obviously there are a lot more varietals out there.
segments.zh: 好吧，显然那里有更多的品种。

segments.en: We only talked about two types of wines.
segments.zh: 我们只谈到了两种葡萄酒。

segments.en: We had a Chardonnay and a Sauvignon Blanc.
segments.zh: 我们有一个霞多丽和一个长相思。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And the only wines we talked about were white wines.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的唯一葡萄酒是白葡萄酒。

segments.en: Of course, there's a whole world of red wines out there.
segments.zh: 当然，那里有一个完整的红酒世界。

segments.en: And then between red and white, you have rosé, which are those pink wines.
segments.zh: 然后在红色和白色之间，你有桃红葡萄酒，它们是那些粉红色的葡萄酒。

segments.en: Those pink wines, yeah.
segments.zh: 那些粉红酒，是的。

segments.en: But actually, it's interesting because the culture of drinking wine is not as extensive as we think it is.
segments.zh: 但实际上，这很有趣，因为喝葡萄酒的文化并不像我们想象的那么广泛。

segments.en: In many parts of the world, they're not really used to drinking wine.
segments.zh: 在世界许多地方，他们并不习惯喝酒。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But then you go to places like France and Italy and South America, like Argentina, Chile, and you experience these different cultures of wine that are quite, I think, quite interesting because they're so different.
segments.zh: 但随后你去法国、意大利和南美等地，比如智利，你会体验到这些不同的葡萄酒文化，我认为这些文化非常有趣，因为它们是如此不同。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: And it's become even healthy to drink wine.
segments.zh: 喝酒变得更健康。

segments.en: Medical tests show that if you have one glass of wine with dinner every day, it reduces your chances of heart disease.
segments.zh: 医学测试表明，如果您每天晚餐时喝一杯葡萄酒，则可以减少患心脏病的机会。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: There's some special ingredient.
segments.zh: 有一些特殊的成分。

segments.en: I'm not sure what it is, but obviously you don't want to drink too much.
segments.zh: 我不确定它是什么，但显然你不想喝太多。

segments.en: But if you have a little bit, it's good for your heart.
segments.zh: 但如果你有一点，那对你的心脏有好处。

segments.en: I think red wine, they say, is good for your heart.
segments.zh: 他们说，我认为红酒对你的心脏有好处。

segments.en: So it's interesting, but obviously, maybe in your countries, you don't drink wine or maybe you have a particular type of wine.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣，但显然，也许在你的国家，你不喝葡萄酒，或者你有一种特定类型的酒。

segments.en: Like in China, they have, isn't it plum wine or rice wine?
segments.zh: 就像在中国一样，他们不是梅酒还是米酒？

segments.en: Rice wine in China and plum wine, I think, in Japan.
segments.zh: 我想，在中国的米酒和梅酒，在日本。

segments.en: So maybe you have a specific type of wine that you want to let us know about.
segments.zh: 所以也许你有一种特定类型的葡萄酒你想让我们知道。

segments.en: And of course, if you have any questions or comments, we're always there.
segments.zh: 当然，如果您有任何问题或意见，我们总是在那里。

segments.en: Check us out at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 在 Englishpod.com 上查看我们。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you again.
segments.zh: 我们会再见到你的。

segments.en: Thanks.
segments.zh: 谢谢。
